SELECT
AS name,
COALESCE(SUM(droitem.amount_after * COALESCE(droi.currency_rate, 0)), 0)
COALESCE(SUM(droitem.amount_after), 0)
COALESCE(SUM(droitem.amount_after * COALESCE(droi.cny_settle_rate, 0)), 0)
AS amount FROM dmp_return_order_item AS droitem left join dmp_return_order_info AS droi on droi.id = droitem.return_order_id
and droi.return_create_time >= #{params.startTime}::timestamp
and droi.return_create_time <= #{params.endTime}::timestamp
AND droitem.sku_no = #{params.skuNo}
GROUP BY ORDER BY name

SELECT
AS name,
COALESCE(SUM(dritem.amount_after * COALESCE(dri.currency_rate, 0)), 0)
COALESCE(SUM(dritem.amount_after), 0)
COALESCE(SUM(dritem.amount_after * COALESCE(dri.cny_settle_rate, 0)), 0)
AS refundAmount, count(distinct dri.platform_order_id) AS refundOrderQty FROM dmp_refund_item AS dritem left join dmp_refund_info AS dri on dri.id = dritem.refund_id
and dri.refund_create_time >= #{params.startTime}::timestamp
and dri.refund_create_time <= #{params.endTime}::timestamp
AND dritem.sku_no = #{params.skuNo}
GROUP BY ORDER BY name
